dataIssueDetail: The EUR derived-maintenance PBE 01uWC000005wzX8YAI (product 01tWC00000DD1bsYAD, BoKS NewMaintenance) has IsDerived=false, while the USD PBE 01uWC000005wsbUYAQ for the SAME product has IsDerived=true. This is a fixable data/config gap, BUT it is org-catalog config a real UI rep would also hit (not a fixture omission): ALL 9 non-USD PBEs for this product have IsDerived=false, and org-wide every one of the 3453 IsDerived=true PBEs is USD (zero non-USD derived PBEs). The proposed fix (PATCH non-USD PBEs to IsDerived=true) is a PricebookEntry config fix, in the SC-3384 currency-completeness family. NOT a malformed-seed / headless-insert artifact.
evidence: FortraUAT, active V21 ESV 9QMWC00000025LN4AY (VersionNumber=21, IsActive=true confirmed). reason: Default TEST-DATA-ARTIFACT hypothesis DISPROVEN by independent fresh re-measurement on the live active V21. All three required conditions affirmatively proven: (1) inputs VALID and matched test_setup -- EUR Renewal quote on active Fortra Price Book, EUR maint PBE active/correct-currency, COLA/Base seeds stamped, and the EUR license line on the same quote priced correctly (15888.2) through the same route, so the route/currency are healthy; the $0-list maint PBE is the CORRECT derived-product structure (the working USD twin has the same $0 list). (2) The intended branch state is confirmed via gating fields: COLACalculatedPrice__c=3666.9 stamps (COLA step engaged on the EUR line) but the derived-net committer never writes NetUnitPrice -- precisely because that committer gates on the derived flag (PBE.IsDerived -> ItemIsDerived__std), which is true only on the USD PBE. The A/B against the structurally identical USD twin (same product/type/flat/$0-PBE, also script-created) which nets 71 isolates the discriminator to PBE.IsDerived, ruling out the headless-Apex-insert hydration trap and a malformed seed. (3) A fresh Force-reprice (isSuccess=true) of the CURRENT active V21 reproduces Net=0/List=0/NetTotal=0 on the EUR maint line, stable. Not EXPECTATION-ERROR: expected is unambiguously non-zero (~3177-3667 depending on basis) and $0 is wrong under every interpretation. Genuine ORG-CONFIG-DEFECT: the SC-3384 currency-completeness gap (non-USD PBEs lack IsDerived=true) that any UI rep building an EUR derived-maint renewal would also hit -- corroborated by 3 pre-existing May-2026 EUR maint lines that also net null/0. Agrees with executor's FAIL / ORG-CONFIG-DEFECT.
